title: Class Schedule Editor notes now pre-fill with a school-day summary
summary: Adding a note to a day that has an A/B day type assigned now starts pre-filled -- title 'School', notes '42nd Day Of School (Monday) 7:45 AM - 2:25 PM' -- computed from that day's actual assigned school-day count and its schedule's overall time span, matching the same '(weekday) time-range' format calendar events already use. Still fully editable, just a real starting point instead of a blank form.
